body_long:
Rosewood Calistoga has set its opening date: 15 April 2027, the first night offered by the booking engine on the brand's website. The resort sits on 118 acres (about 48 hectares) of forested ridgeline in northern Napa Valley, a short walk from the centre of Calistoga. It will be Rosewood's third address in California.

## 96 keys and 33 residences

The hotel counts 96 keys, including 31 suites, three of them Signature Suites. Estate, Forest View and Vineyard View rooms measure about 46 m², each with a terrace, a fire pit and a freestanding bath. Suites reach about 93 m² with a fireplace and a separate living room, and three lodges of about 140 m² come with a kitchen and two bathrooms.

Alongside the hotel, Rosewood Residences Calistoga comprises 20 private villas of four or five bedrooms and 13 estate homesites. Owners will have access to the resort's services.

## Rates and bookings

La Revue des Hôtels found rates from $2,500 a night before tax for an Estate King room on 15 April 2027, and $3,000 for a Vineyard View room. One Mile at a Time reports that the resort was first bookable through Rosewood Elite travel advisers, with public reservations opening on 4 November 2026.

## Design and wellness

The architecture follows the vision of the late Ed Tuttle, carried forward by the studio Atelier Marsh. The buildings are set into the contours of the land. The Asaya wellness space will have six treatment rooms, a hydrotherapy area, a gym and a movement studio. There will be two pools, one for adults and one for families, and a children's club. Dining will include a signature restaurant built around garden and local farm produce, a cocktail bar with a wine programme and a poolside restaurant facing the vines; names have not yet been revealed.

## The team

Daniel Simon was appointed Managing Director of Rosewood Calistoga and Rosewood Residences Calistoga in August 2026. Born in Sweden, he joined Rosewood Hotel Group in 2021 and most recently led Rosewood Phnom Penh, after roles with Four Seasons, W Hotels and Anantara. James Tattersall, appointed in January 2026, is Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing for Rosewood Calistoga and Rosewood Sand Hill and sits on the pre-opening executive committee. Rosewood Hotel Group is owned by Chow Tai Fook Enterprises and led by CEO Sonia Cheng.

## The signal

Opening to travel advisers before the public lets a brand anchor its price with the clients least sensitive to it. At $2,500 a night for an entry room, Rosewood is pricing Calistoga as a destination in itself, not as a wine-country stopover, and testing how far Napa's luxury ceiling can rise.
summary: Rosewood Calistoga will open on 15 April 2027 on 118 acres in northern Napa Valley, with 96 keys including 31 suites, plus 20 villas and 13 homesites. Rates start at $2,500 a night before tax; public bookings open on 4 November after an adviser-only window. Daniel Simon leads the opening as Managing Director.
title: Rosewood Calistoga sets 15 April 2027 opening, from $2,500 a night
